shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [[ -f ../round-brief.md ]]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi
sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md
sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat ../round-brief.md
git status --short
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'command -v lore-query-trace || true
command -v lore_get_ci_failures || true
rg -n "lore_get_ci_failures|lore-query-trace|changelog" .lore scripts package.json .github 2>/dev/null | head -100
git log --oneline -6
git show --stat --oneline HEAD'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' src/types/messages.ts
rg -n \"SessionSummary|IncomingMessage|OutgoingMessage|ListSessions|SessionList\" src/index.ts src/types src/transport/ws/*.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
sed -n '1,230p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,80p' CHANGELOG.md
cat package.json | sed -n '1,180p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '80,135p' src/index.ts
sed -n '1,45p' src/types/index.ts
sed -n '1,180p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
rg -n \"specs/.*#|@spec|spec:\" src/**/*.test.ts | head -40
rg --files scripts | rg 'reanchor|spec-links'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "specs/[''^"]+#|spec-anchor|@spec" src --glob '"'*.test.ts' | head -80
sed -n '1,70p' src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts
rg -n '"'^## |''^### '"' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md | tail -25"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/.*#|spec-anchor|@spec' src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -80
sed -n '1,90p' src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts
rg -n '"'^## |''^### '"' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md | tail -25"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/[a-z0-9-]+/spec\\.md#[0-9]+' . --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' | head -80
rg -n 'VALIDATED_BY|validated by' src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -40"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/types/messages.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts
rg -n 'createMessageHandler' src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/ws/*.test.ts | head -40
sed -n '1,120p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts
sed -n '1,160p' src/transport/ws/sender.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,100p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
sed -n '30,55p' src/transport/createServer.ts
sed -n '1,75p' src/types/sessionStore.ts"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/conversationList.test.ts'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/conversationList.test.ts'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/conversationList.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/transport/ws/conversationList.test.ts | sed -n '1,25p'
nl -ba src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '155,170p'
git diff --check
git diff --stat"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short
rg -n 'conversationList' .gitignore .git/info/exclude || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/index.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/conversationList.test.ts src/types/index.ts src/types/messages.ts
timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/conversationList.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check
git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/types/messages.ts src/types/index.ts src/index.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/conversationList.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md CHANGELOG.md
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write CHANGELOG.md
git diff --check
git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/index.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/conversationList.test.ts src/types/index.ts src/types/messages.ts
git commit -m "feat(transport): answer conversation list frames"
git push origin HEAD'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main
git merge --no-edit origin/main
if [[ $(git rev-list --count '"'@{upstream}..HEAD') -gt 0 ]]; then git push origin HEAD; fi
git status --short --branch
git rev-list --left-right --count '@{upstream}...HEAD'"
